name: notifications
title: Notifications
summary: Who is told what, on which channel: notification topics for customers, sellers and staff, routing from platform events to recipients (staff by role, with backups), templates with versions and preview, in-app inboxes for the store, Seller Center and Admin Center, email delivery with retries and suppression, seller and staff channel preferences, promotional broadcasts under consent, and Android push devices (phase 3).
owns: Topic catalogue: every notice per audience with category (essential, optional, promotional), inbox group, link target, deadline and channels (in-app and email at launch; SMS phase 2; push phase 3)

Routing rules from platform events to topics and recipients: customers, guests by checkout email, seller members by permission and preference, staff by role through access (lead, or backup while the lead is away)
Templates per topic and channel with variables, drafts, preview on desktop and phone, test sends, published versions and restore
In-app inboxes: customer (account/notifications), seller (seller/notifications), staff (admin/inbox) with read state, action-required notices and deadlines
Scheduled notices (e.g. dispatch deadline reminder 4 hours before) and resolution of action notices when the work is done
Delivery log per channel with provider ids, retries with backoff, bounce and complaint handling and the suppression list
Seller member notification preferences (set by the owner; essential notices always reach the owner) and staff email preferences
Promotional broadcasts (newsletter, seller tips) only to people who opted in, with one-click unsubscribe tokens
Inbound email replies to case and message emails, handed to support and messaging
notOwns: Customer promotional consent per channel (email, SMS, push promotions, wishlist alerts) and the unsubscribe endpoint: customers (notifications reads getMarketingConsent, consumes customers.marketing_preferences.changed and signs the unsubscribe tokens customers verifies)
Order, return, case and payout facts shown in notices: the publishing modules (notices link to their records and never become the source of truth)
Who leads or backs up a role, and away periods: access
Work items, overdue timers and escalation routes: workqueues (it publishes workqueues.item.overdue/escalated; notifications delivers them)
Conversations and case threads: messaging and support (notifications only announces new messages and forwards email replies)
Campaign content and audiences for marketing: promotions (a broadcast references a promotional template and a consent channel)

publicApi.name: notify
publicApi.desc: Send a topic to recipients now (for cases not covered by the event routing rules, e.g. mentions, test notices, guest order links). Essential topics ignore promotional consent; promotional topics check it.

publicApi.name: schedule

publicApi.name: cancelScheduled

publicApi.name: resolve

publicApi.desc: Tokens in promotional footers are signed here; customers' public unsubscribe endpoint verifies them

stateMachines.name: Template version
stateMachines.notes: One draft per template at a time. publish is blocked while validation has blocking issues (missing required variable such as the record link, promotional content in an essential topic, unknown variable). Publishing supersedes the previous live version. Restore = start a new draft from an old version.

stateMachines.name: Delivery
stateMachines.notes: skip: promotional without consent, member preference off, account closed, duplicate dedupeKey. suppress: address on the suppression list (hard bounce, complaint). Retries back off (1, 5, 15, 60, 240 min) up to maxDeliveryAttempts, then failed and notifications.delivery.failed. A hard bounce adds a suppression and publishes notifications.address.suppressed. In-app notices are written in the same transaction as the triggering event handling and never depend on email delivery.

stateMachines.name: Broadcast
stateMachines.notes: Recipients are resolved at start from consent (customers.getMarketingConsent, seller member promotions group) minus suppressions; quiet hours apply to SMS and push.

stateMachines.name: Action notice
stateMachines.notes: Only notices with actionRequired. resolve comes from the owning module (resolve(dedupeKey)) when the work is done and sets resolvedAt; expire (purge job, daily) sets expiredAt and never resolvedAt: an open action notice expires actionNoticeExpiryDays after its deadline, or, when it has no deadline, actionNoticeExpiryDays after it was created (the owning module never resolved it, so the record closed another way). Read state is separate and per person.

consumes.name: advertising.campaign.ending_soon

consumes.name: reviews.moderation.decided

consumes.name: trust.rights_report.received

consumes.name: trust.evidence.requested

consumes.name: trust.appeal.decided

consumes.name: payments.refund.destination_requested

consumes.name: customers.closure.delayed

consumes.name: offers.offer.missing_items_stale

consumes.name: inventory.stock.low_digest

Replaces one notice per item for non-urgent low stock

consumes.name: sellers.application.information_reminder

consumes.name: sellers.member.invited

consumes.name: sellers.member.joined

consumes.name: sellers.member.removed

consumes.name: catalog.product.submitted

consumes.name: catalog.brand.requested

consumes.name: catalog.correction.decided
consumes.does: Resolve the correction notice (correction:<suggestionId>); sends nothing

consumes.name: sellers.change_request.submitted
consumes.does: Staff (topic staff.seller.change_requested, Seller Manager role): a store name, tagline, storefront claim, brand request or business change waits for review; action required until decided (change-request:<changeRequestId>)

consumes.name: sellers.launch_review.requested

consumes.name: sellers.application.information_provided

consumes.name: sellers.appeal.submitted

consumes.name: sellers.restriction.evidence_submitted

consumes.name: trust.appeal.submitted
consumes.does: Staff (topic staff.trust.appeal_submitted, Trust and Risk Manager role): an appeal against a trust enforcement to decide by its deadline; action required until trust.appeal.decided (trust-appeal-review:<appealId>)

consumes.name: reviews.appeal.submitted
consumes.does: Staff (topic staff.moderation.appeal_submitted, Content Manager role): an author appeals a moderation decision; action required until decided (moderation-appeal:<appealId>)

consumes.name: reviews.appeal.decided
consumes.does: Resolve the moderation appeal notice (moderation-appeal:<appealId>); sends nothing

permissions.desc: View the notification matrix, templates, previews and delivery stats
Turn channels on or off per topic (Platform Administrator)
Read the delivery log (support, Platform Administrator)
Create, schedule and cancel promotional broadcasts (Marketing Manager)
Set notification preferences for every seller member (owner by default)

jobs.name: notifications.dispatch
jobs.does: Also started at once after notices are queued. Render and send queued deliveries per channel with provider rate limits; mark sent

jobs.name: notifications.retry
jobs.does: Re-send retrying deliveries whose nextAttemptAt passed; give up after maxDeliveryAttempts (notifications.delivery.failed)

jobs.name: notifications.send-scheduled
jobs.does: Send scheduled notices due now (dispatch deadline reminders 4 h before, drop-off reminders, approval due reminders)

jobs.name: notifications.send-broadcasts
jobs.does: Start scheduled broadcasts, resolve consenting recipients, respect quiet hours for SMS and push, publish notifications.broadcast.sent

jobs.name: notifications.staff-digest
jobs.does: Email the daily digest to staff who chose it (08:00 is the start of business hours; on closed days it waits for the next open day)

jobs.name: notifications.purge
jobs.does: Delete notices older than noticeRetentionMonths and delivery rows older than deliveryLogRetentionDays; mark unresolved action notices expired (expired_at, not resolved_at) actionNoticeExpiryDays after their deadline, or after they were created when they have no deadline

settings.desc: An unresolved action notice is marked expired (No longer needed) this many days after its deadline, or after it was created when it has no deadline
Notices are kept for 12 months (seller inbox copy)
Same dedupeKey and recipient is sent once in this window
Domain for reply-to tokens on case and message emails
Test sends only to these domains
Hours before the dispatch deadline for the seller reminder (scheduled when shipping or orders call schedule)
No promotional SMS or push in this local window

integrations.name: Transactional email provider (e.g. Amazon SES, Postmark)
integrations.purpose: Send email, delivery/bounce/complaint webhooks, inbound parse for replies; DKIM/SPF/DMARC on the sending domains; List-Unsubscribe headers on promotional mail

integrations.name: SMS provider (e.g. Twilio)
integrations.purpose: Phase 2: 2-step codes, delivery problems and opted-in SMS promotions; STOP handling

integrations.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
integrations.purpose: Phase 3: Android push for customers and sellers; invalid tokens are dropped

integrations.name: Template rendering
integrations.purpose: Mustache-style variables with escaping; MJML layout for responsive email; plain-text alternative always generated

GROUP_LOCKED.meaning: That topic group cannot be changed for this member (essential for the owner, or owner-only).

CHANNEL_LOCKED.meaning: In-app cannot be turned off for essential topics.

CHANNEL_NOT_AVAILABLE.meaning: The channel is planned for a later phase (SMS 2, push 3).

DRAFT_EXISTS.meaning: This template already has a draft (details.versionId).

TEMPLATE_INVALID.meaning: Blocking validation issues, e.g. missing required link variable. details.issues.

TEST_RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: Test sends only go to staff addresses (testSendDomains).

ADDRESS_SUPPRESSED.meaning: The address is suppressed; remove the suppression first.

NOT_RETRYABLE.meaning: Sensitive content (codes, links) expired; the person must request a new one.

TOPIC_NOT_PROMOTIONAL.meaning: Broadcasts can only use promotional topics.

MEMBER_NOT_JOINED.meaning: The member has been invited and has not accepted yet; notification preferences open once they join.

NOTICE_ACTION_OPEN.meaning: The notice still needs action; it can be archived once the work is done.

notes: Coverage (plan ch. 19). Customer essential: order accepted, payment result, dispatch with tracking, delays, delivery, cancellation, return updates, refund updates, case replies, security alerts. Seller essential: application result, requested corrections, new orders, dispatch deadline reminder and overdue, returns, cases, restrictions, payout results (plus holds, negative balance, payout destination change and its verification result, change-request decisions, Verified seller label changes and the launch review result: plan ch. 10 material changes with their impact on selling or payouts). Staff essential: overdue shipping, stock shortages, waiting approvals, escalated cases, failed payouts, unusual financial activity (plus overdue work items, integrity alerts). Promotional: customer newsletter and coupons (weekly), price-drop and back-in-stock alerts (phase 3 with wishlist), seller tips and campaigns (monthly).

Essential vs promotional: essential notices cannot be turned off (in-app always, email always for customers and seller owners); they never carry promotional content (template validation blocks it). Promotional sends check consent (customers for customers, the member's promotions group for sellers), suppression and account status, and carry a one-click unsubscribe token verified by customers' public unsubscribe endpoint (seller members change it in Seller Center preferences).

Staff routing: staff topics name roles, not people. access.resolveRecipients(role) returns the lead, or the first available backup while the lead is away or locked; the away lead also gets a copy to see on return (reason backup / coveringFor shown on the notice). Approvals go to the eligible approvers listed by access. When nobody can receive a role's notice (nobody holds the role, or everyone holding it is away or locked) it goes to that role's escalation role instead (one step, usually the Business Owner), addressed to the escalation role, so a review is never left without anyone told. Email to staff follows each person's preferences; urgent topics always email.

Seller routing: seller topics are addressed to the seller workspace and fanned out to members who hold the topic's seller permission (from sellers.getMemberAccess) and have the group on; owner-only groups (payouts and holds) reach only the owner; essential groups always reach the owner by email.

Every notice links to its record (NoticeLink.screen + id); templates must include the link variable (validation). Notices say what happened and what to do next with the deadline; they never claim more than the event says (e.g. 'refund approved' never says the money has arrived; 'dispatched' never says 'in transit' before a carrier scan).
Guests: notices for guest orders go by email only (recipient kind guest_email) and include the guest order link minted by customers.

Default templates: install seeds version 1 of every topic and channel from the built-in defaults. A template nobody edited (every version written by the system) follows the defaults: when a default changes (e.g. the purchase order email gained the Deliver to line), the boot seed publishes a new system version (note Default template updated) and supersedes the old one. A template with any staff version is never touched.

Sensitive events (codes, reset links, invitation links) are rendered and sent without storing the secret: the delivery row keeps the template version and a redacted subject; such deliveries are not retryable from the log.

Android: push arrives in phase 3; until then the app polls GET /inbox/summary on resume. Push payloads carry only the title, a short body and the NoticeLink, never personal details beyond the order reference.

Fulfilled by Marketly topics (fulfillment-service sends them all through notify; notifications declares the topics and default templates). Seller topics in the new preference group fulfillment_service (label 'Fulfilled by Marketly', permission fulfillment-service.inbound.manage, not owner-only, essential for the owner, default on): seller.fulfillment.enrollment_decided (context enrollment.state, reason), seller.fulfillment.sku_reviewed (sku, approved, reason), seller.fulfillment.inbound_received (inbound.ref, received, damaged, discrepancy), seller.fulfillment.stock_available (inbound.ref, units), seller.fulfillment.discrepancy_decided (inbound.ref, decision), seller.fulfillment.order_received (order.ref, items), seller.fulfillment.return_inspected (return.ref, outcome), seller.fulfillment.removal_completed (removal.ref, units), seller.fulfillment.stock_low (stock.label, available), seller.fulfillment.stock_aged (units, effective), seller.fulfillment.disposal_scheduled (units, days, removal.ref), seller.fulfillment.fee_schedule_changed (version, effective), seller.fulfillment.offboarding (removal.refs). Staff topics: staff.fulfillment.enrollment_submitted (role seller_manager), staff.fulfillment.inbound_submitted (role warehouse_manager), staff.fulfillment.discrepancy_claimed (role warehouse_manager). The dedupe keys are listed in the fulfillment-service spec notes.

Fulfilled by Marketly routing: event routing never sends a seller a shipping or dispatch notice for a group with fulfilledBy marketly_service (new order, dispatch reminder, dispatch overdue, cancellation request, delivery exceptions), and skips the generic seller low-stock notice when inventory.stock.low is serviceManaged.
